description: Is Celestia Fibre ready? Status of the Celestia Fibre network (CIP-51, validator-operated blob publishing) from Cumulo's open Fibre Network Monitor: whether enough stake has a ready Fibre host to reach the 2/3 threshold, how many validators registered a host and are ready, how fast each probe region reaches 2/3, how many validators, hosting providers or countries could fail before ready stake drops below 2/3, validators still missing a host, fee and escrow parameters, whether validators keep the data they signed, the network history, and Cumulo's weekly and monthly reports. Cumulo monitors the Mocha testnet (mocha-5) today. Figures are measured and computed by Cumulo from probes in several regions and relayed unchanged, with Cumulo credited. Pick a view: overview, quorum, liveness, concentration, missing, payments, retention, method, history or report. Validator names are typed by the validators and marked untrusted. For one validator use get_fibre_validator; for blobs and fees use get_fibre_blob_market. For the hardware a Fibre node needs use size_fibre_node.

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)

limit.description: For view concentration: rows per list

period.description: For view report: week, month, year, or a named period such as 2026-W40, 2026-09 or 2026

view.description: overview = readiness against 2/3 plus the headline numbers; quorum = time to reach 2/3 per region; liveness = how many failures break 2/3; concentration = share by hosting provider and country; missing = validators without a ready host; payments = fee formula, parameters, escrow; retention = do hosts keep the data they signed; method = how Cumulo measures each figure; history = readiness over time; report = Cumulo's week or month report

name: get_fibre_network_status
